details: The August US jobs report significantly surpassed Wall Street's expectations, revealing 162,000 new nonfarm payrolls, nearly triple the forecast. This strong employment data has substantially increased the probability of the Federal Reserve implementing an interest rate hike at its upcoming September 15-16 meeting, with market odds now standing at 58-60%. The prospect of tighter monetary policy, which typically diminishes the attractiveness of riskier assets, led to Bitcoin falling below the $80,000 mark.
title: Robust US Jobs Report Boosts Fed Hike Odds, Pressures Bitcoin

details: Cryptocurrency markets are experiencing heightened caution as investors await crucial macroeconomic data, including the latest US inflation figures and the European Central Bank's (ECB) forthcoming interest rate decisions. This anticipation, coupled with the increased likelihood of further rate hikes from both the Federal Reserve and potentially the ECB, is contributing to short-term selling pressure on major digital assets like Bitcoin and Ethereum. Market participants are closely watching these events for signals on future monetary policy.
title: Crypto Investors Eye US Inflation, Upcoming ECB Rate Decisions
